partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: Specific shared-phenotype indication transfer
results.hypothesis: A drug's treated indication can support a mechanistically linked candidate disease when the two diseases share a relatively specific phenotype.
results.body: training-treated anchor and inhibited causal-target candidate share an exact phenotype occurring in <=34 diseases
results.mechanism_rationale: The candidate has a direct causal-target mechanism and phenotype similarity to a treated indication, but the target mechanism need not be shared by the anchor.
results.trapi_notes: The treatment, target, and phenotype paths are TRAPI-expressible; source exclusion and phenotype/ontology degree constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[treatment:TREATS|AMELIORATES_CONDITION]->(anchor:Disease)
WHERE any(
  source IN coalesce(treatment.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  WHERE NOT source IN ['infores:drug-repurposing-hub', 'infores:ttd']
)
MATCH (subject)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (anchor)-[:HAS_PHENOTYPE]->(phenotype:PhenotypicFeature)
      <-[:HAS_PHENOTYPE]-(object)
WHERE anchor <> object
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND phenotype._miner_disease_member_degree <= 34
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Repeated shared-phenotype indication transfer
results.hypothesis: Two or more specific shared phenotypes provide stronger disease similarity for indication transfer than a single phenotype.
results.body: R123 with at least two distinct shared phenotypes
results.mechanism_rationale: Repeated phenotype similarity and a direct candidate target mechanism reduce single-hub matches, but the treated anchor need not share the target mechanism.
results.trapi_notes: The positive paths are TRAPI-expressible; phenotype cardinality, source exclusion, and degree constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[treatment:TREATS|AMELIORATES_CONDITION]->(anchor:Disease)
WHERE any(
  source IN coalesce(treatment.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  WHERE NOT source IN ['infores:drug-repurposing-hub', 'infores:ttd']
)
MATCH (subject)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (anchor)-[:HAS_PHENOTYPE]->(phenotype:PhenotypicFeature)
      <-[:HAS_PHENOTYPE]-(object)
WHERE anchor <> object
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND phenotype._miner_disease_member_degree <= 34
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
WITH subject, object, anchor, gene, count(DISTINCT phenotype) AS phenotype_count
WHERE phenotype_count >= 2
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Phenotype-and-anatomy indication transfer
results.hypothesis: Indication transfer is more credible when treated and candidate diseases share both a specific phenotype and a specific anatomy.
results.body: R123 plus exact shared disease anatomy with disease-location degree <=50
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule combines candidate target mechanism, phenotype similarity, and anatomical concordance, but the anchor and candidate may have different causal mechanisms.
results.trapi_notes: The positive phenotype and anatomy paths are TRAPI-expressible; shared-node identity, source exclusion, and degree constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[treatment:TREATS|AMELIORATES_CONDITION]->(anchor:Disease)
WHERE any(
  source IN coalesce(treatment.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  WHERE NOT source IN ['infores:drug-repurposing-hub', 'infores:ttd']
)
MATCH (subject)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (anchor)-[:HAS_PHENOTYPE]->(phenotype:PhenotypicFeature)
      <-[:HAS_PHENOTYPE]-(object)
MATCH (anchor)-[:LOCATED_IN|OCCURS_IN]->(anatomy:AnatomicalEntity)
      <-[:LOCATED_IN|OCCURS_IN]-(object)
WHERE anchor <> object
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND phenotype._miner_disease_member_degree <= 34
  AND anatomy._miner_disease_location_degree <= 50
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Shared-target and shared-phenotype indication transfer
results.hypothesis: The strongest phenotype transfer requires treated and candidate diseases to share both a specific phenotype and the same inhibited causal target.
results.body: R123 plus the inhibited gene is causal for both treated anchor and candidate
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule preserves an identical target mechanism and disease phenotype similarity, but disease-driving target activity direction remains absent.
results.trapi_notes: The positive paths are TRAPI-expressible; source exclusion, shared-target identity, and phenotype/ontology degree constraints require post-processing.
